extracted.intended_audience: NIH extramural grantee organizations, institutional grant administrators, PIs, SOs, AOs, AAs, FSRs, FCOI staff, reviewers (IAR), and other eRA Commons users
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and operational standards for using the eRA Commons system: roles and privileges, module-specific requirements (FFR, FCOI, reference letters, change-of-institution/relinquishing statements), login/password policies, delegation, and submission workflows for NIH grants administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: User Roles determine features and tasks
rubrics_metrics.description: To log in to Commons and access its features, you must have a Commons account with assigned user role(s). User roles determine which features you can employ, the tasks you can perform, and the level of access you have to information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Roles range from trainee roles to scientific roles to administrative roles; see specific role entries for privileges and constraints. Roles control module access, ability to create/modify accounts, submit reports, view summary statements, submit JIT, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account Administrator (AA) privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: AA: Account Administrator at an organization, who facilitates the administration of Commons accounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you hold an AA role, you have privileges to: create accounts and modify all Commons roles except IAR and FCOI roles; create affiliation between an existing PI or IAR Commons account and the institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Official (AO) privileges and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: AO: Administrative Official of an organization who can create many account types and view institutional grant status but cannot submit reports or modify the Institution Profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AO may create all accounts other than IAR, TRAINEE, and FCOI; update Commons accounts created by the AO; view status and award information for all institution grants. NOTE: The AO cannot view summary statements or priority scores, cannot modify the Institution Profile, and is not authorized to submit reports to the NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistant (ASST) privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: ASST: An assistant who may be delegated to perform tasks on behalf of the PD/PI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May edit own personal profile; edit PD/PI PPF if delegated; edit PD/PI progress report data if delegated; view PD/PI Grant Status if delegated; perform PD/PI xTrain functions (except submit to agency) if delegated by the PI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business Official (BO) privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: BO: Business Official at an organization who manages trainee grants and uses the xTrain module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BO can view trainee roster, list of grants, grant summary, routing history, PDF appointments/amendments/terminations, and initiate/update/route/submit Termination Notices (if authorized).

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Conflict of Interest (FCOI) role and reporting responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: FCOI users manage the Financial Conflict of Interest reporting process in Commons; SO assigns the FCOI role to an institutional user with a Commons account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FCOI responsibilities: initiate FCOI, view/edit/delete FCOI, submit FCOI reports. Reporting to comply with Federal regulation (Title 42 CFR Part 50 Subpart F) is required; SO may delegate FCOI responsibilities via FCOI_ASST or FCOI_View roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: FCOI Assistant (FCOI_ASST) privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: FCOI_ASST: assists with FCOI reporting and has broader privileges than read-only users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Privileges include: initiate FCOI, search FCOI, view/edit/delete FCOI. Use FCOI_View instead for users who only need to view/search (read-only).

rubrics_metrics.name: FCOI Read-Only (FCOI_View) privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: FCOI_View: read-only access to search for and view FCOI information entered by the institution in the FCOI module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assign FCOI_View to users who need view/search authority only; assign FCOI_ASST to users who must perform data entry or edits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Financial Report (FSR/FFR) role
rubrics_metrics.description: FSR role: assigned for completing Federal Financial Report responsibilities; a user with only FSR role can only perform FFR tasks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you hold an FSR role, you can create, view, submit, and revise FFRs for your institution. FSR duties may be combined with SO or BO/AO depending on institutional workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet Assisted Review (IAR) reviewer role
rubrics_metrics.description: IAR: Reviewer selected by Scientific Review Officer (SRO) to critique and score applications using the IAR module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IAR users can edit their PPF and reviewer address data, and use the IAR module to submit critiques and preliminary scores for enabled review meetings. IAR authority is enabled by an SRO; many PD/PIs are assigned this role automatically when selected as reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Director/Principal Investigator (PI) privileges and constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: PI (also displayed as PD/PI) directs a research project and may perform or delegate grant-administration responsibilities in Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PI can edit personal profile, delegate edit authority, view status of grants where designated PD/PI, view assembled application image, view study section/meeting roster, view review outcome and summary statements, view NOA, delegate authority to ASSTs, initiate progress reports and delegate progress report authority, and perform xTrain PI tasks (initiate/update/route/submit certain items). NOTE: PI users cannot delegate authority to submit appointments to the Agency, and PI role should not be combined with SO role (but can be combined with IAR).

rubrics_metrics.name: Signing Official (SO) privileges and constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: SO: Organization's Signing Official with institutional authority to legally bind the institution in grant-administration matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SO can register applicant institutions, create/update the Institutional Profile, create/delete/update all Commons accounts (except IAR and TRAINEE), create affiliations, submit electronic grant applications via Grants.gov if also Registered AOR, view status and assembled images, reject grant applications to address submission warnings, view award information, submit JIT info for PD/PI, delegate progress report authority and submit progress reports to Agency, submit final progress reports and one-time No-Cost Extensions, and assign FCOI role. NOTE: An SO cannot view summary statements or priority scores and SO role should never be combined with a PI role.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor (SPONSOR) role in xTrain
rubrics_metrics.description: SPONSOR: supervises research training of fellows in xTrain and is associated with fellowships in the institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sponsor can view trainee roster, list of grants, review termination notices and route to BO, initiate termination notices for fellows who left, and delegate sponsor authority to another individual. SO or AO can add Sponsor role to an account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trainee, Postdoc, Undergraduate, and Project Personnel roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Project-personnel roles (TRAINEE, POSTDOC, Undergraduate, Project Personnel) provide role-specific xTrain and project access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TRAINEE manages own electronic appointments and views PDF appointments/amendments/terminations; POSTDOC and Undergraduate roles indicate participation time and are used for reporting; Project Personnel role is assigned for other project roles. See notice NOT-OD-13-097 for more information about person-month reporting roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Welcome to Commons screen: items to review
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon accessing Commons, review the Welcome screen for several important resources and notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information includes: Commons Login (username/password), eRA Commons Help Desk hours/contact, System Notification Message (outages/maintenance), Supported Related Resources, Commons Related Resources (reference letter, demo), Register Grantee Organization link, What's New, Commons Resources (FAQs, training, release notes), and Additional Links (Grants.gov, iEdison, NIH, Loan Repayment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letters submission requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference letters must be submitted through eRA Commons between FOA posting and the application deadline; referee does not need a Commons role but the candidate must have a Commons account with PI role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters must be no longer than 2 pages and in PDF format. Required information from candidate: PI Commons User ID, PI's last name as on Commons account, FOA number, FOA opening date and deadline. Once submitted, referee and candidate receive confirmation; candidate cannot see the submitted reference. To correct a reference, resubmit using the original Reference Letter Confirmation #.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Financial Report (FFR) submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH requires all financial expenditure data (initial and revised) to be submitted via eRA Commons using the appropriate FFR/FSR form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FFR module allows creation, viewing, submission, and revision of FFRs; with transition from FSR to FFR, revised FSRs should also be submitted in FSR format and eRA Commons will select the correct form automatically. See the FFR user guide or online help for detailed instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: FCOI reporting must comply with federal regulation
rubrics_metrics.description: The FCOI reporting process allows institutions to report identified financial conflicts of interest to the Agency as required by Title 42 Code of Federal Regulation Part 50 Subpart F for grants and cooperative agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SO completes reporting unless delegated. For additional reporting requirements and FAQs, refer to the Office of Extramural Research FCOI website and the FCOI user guide or Commons Online Help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing Statement (RS) and Change of Institution validation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Change of Institution/Relinquishing Statement workflow imposes specific business rules and validation checks for eligible grants and required data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Error/validation messages include: required field enforcement ('You must enter the following required fields to proceed <field>'), 'No grants to relinquish have been found' if grant not found, 'New Institution Name is a required field', 'Please enter data in the Email Address field (e.g. user_name@domain_name.com) (ID:30102)', 'Termination Date is a required field. (ID:200241)', 'The requested Termination Date must be within the current budget period.' Financial validation messages include: 'Direct Cost is a required field.'; 'The direct costs being relinquished must not exceed the direct costs for the current budget period for transfers of active awards.'; 'The indirect costs being relinquished must not exceed the direct costs for the current budget period for transfers of active awards.'; 'The total costs being relinquished must not exceed the costs for the current budget period for transfers of active awards.' Maximum field constraints: 'Direct Cost amount cannot exceed 999,999,999.' 'Indirect Cost amount cannot exceed 999,999,999.' 'Total Cost amount cannot exceed 999,999,999.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing Statement email notifications and timing reminders
rubrics_metrics.description: The system sends automated email notifications at different RS processing stages and timed reminders related to change-of-institution actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: acknowledgment of RS receipt by NIH; returned RS with reviewer comments; RS visible to new institution after IPF entry; Change of Institution Application Reminder (30 days after RS submit date) instructing new institution to provide GMO with change of institution application prior to anticipated start date; RS Reminder Notice (30 days after change of institution application submit date) to SOs at former institution. Emails include contact information for GMOs and eRA Help Desk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation rules and processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Commons supports delegation of authorities (delegate on behalf of another user, institutional delegations, direct delegations) with specific screens and privileges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delegations include: delegate progress report authority, delegate sponsor authority, revoke authority, institutional delegation to grant submit progress report authority, revoke institutional delegation, and direct delegations for individuals. Delegation changes are performed via Admin module screens (My Delegates, Institution Delegations) and reflected in system search/results; certain authorizations (e.g., submit to agency) remain restricted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission/workflow constraints for specific roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain submission actions are restricted by role (e.g., only SO can submit JIT for a PD/PI; PI cannot submit appointments to Agency; AO cannot submit reports).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: PI users cannot delegate authority to submit appointments to the Agency; an AO is not authorized to submit reports to the NIH; SO may submit JIT and progress reports and assign FCOI roles. Role combinations are cautioned against (SO+PI should not be combined).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letter submission process and confirmation handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Process for submitting, attaching, and correcting a reference letter through Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Steps: access public Commons submit page, fill required fields (marked with red asterisk), attach PDF reference letter via Browse, submit. After submission both referee and candidate receive confirmation. To submit a corrected letter, reaccess form, enter previous submission's Reference Letter Confirmation #, attach corrected PDF, and submit. Fellowship/Career Development may accept letters on institutional letterhead; check FOA for form requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: System error handling guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: When unexpected system errors occur, Commons produces messages instructing users to contact support or correct input per validation messages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'An unexpected error occurred. Please contact eRA Help Desk.' and field-specific error messages indicating missing or invalid inputs. Users should follow the exact error text and contact eRA Help Desk or Grants Management contacts as indicated in messages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation and help resources requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Users are directed to online help topics, PDF user guides, tutorials, and the eRA Help Desk for module-specific procedures and troubleshooting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: FFR topics at era.nih.gov/erahelp/commons/#Commons/FFR/ffr_intro.htm; Federal Financial Report user guide PDF; FCOI External User Guide; IAR for Reviewers online help; tutorial videos (YouTube) for reference letters. Contact eRA Help Desk (preferred web method) or phone for troubleshooting.
